==Notes==
*Singed Oaks were probably [[Oakheart (Ascalon)|Oakhearts]] before they were damaged by [[the Searing]].
*Singed Oaks can charm a nearby [[Moa Bird]] if one is available, but this is pretty rare. They're unable to use their pet attacks without a pet.
